fix: tests/helpers/world-v4.mjs now sanitizes base names using THREE.PropertyBinding.sanitizeNodeName and runs finishOcean before indexing, matching preview/main.js.
conclusion: Neither object was lost from the application or save. All 8,407 pre-v6 state IDs exist; only subsequently deleted QA objects are intentionally absent.
